_doc: One look per archival film (brief.json "look", default paper). Read by scenes/lib.js, maps/engine.html and scripts/render.py. User 2026-11-14 after the 通史3 reference: one colour family for the whole film, vintage book graphics, real photos as framed exhibits. Colours as hex; every scene, map, card and overlay draws only from its look. Roles: fg text/lines, fg2 secondary text, panel tag boxes, accent the calm second colour (paper navy), accent2 the one mark colour (muted red: arrows, rules, dots), highlight a rare gold.
